subject: general
question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)? (Dec 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vivek Chaturvedi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India has appointed Vivek Chaturvedi, a 1990-batch IRS (Customs & Indirect Taxes) officer, as the new Chairman of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **His appointment was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC).**
 
• **Vivek Chaturvedi has more than 30 years of experience in indirect taxes, policy formulation, compliance, and institutional leadership.**
 
• **Before joining CBIC as Member, he served as Principal Director General of Vigilance and Chief Vigilance Officer.**
 
• **He succeeds Sanjay Kumar Agarwal, a 1988-batch IRS officer who retired on 28 November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vivek Chaturvedi**__

 __
 
• 1990-batch IRS officer (Customs & Indirect Taxes).
 
• Known for strengthening internal vigilance, transparency, and administrative discipline.
 
• Led reforms in internal controls and compliance during his Vigilance tenure.
 
 
 
• **Role of CBIC Chairman**__
 __
 
• Heads India’s indirect tax administration, including GST, customs, and central excise.
 
• Oversees policy implementation, compliance, enforcement, and taxpayer services.
 
 
 
• **About Former Chairman Sanjay Kumar Agarwal**__
 __
 
• 1988-batch IRS officer.
 
• Retired on 28 November 2025 after completing his term.
 
• Contributed to strengthening GST systems and improving customs processes.
 
 
 
• **Institutional Context**__
 
 
• CBIC operates under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.
 
• Plays a central role in tax policy, trade facilitation, and revenue generation.
